answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 157756 Country: India Title: I have a few proposals for marriage from families where the father earned money from banking job in India. Obviously, the family is raised on haram money. Is it preferable to marry in such families? Question: I have a few proposals for marriage from families where the father earned money from banking job in India. Obviously, the family is raised on haram money. Is it preferable to marry in such families? Answer ID: 157756 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 479/400/B=4/1439) Marrying in such family is avoidable and not preferable. Those who are nourished with haram wealth usually they are not good in respect to instinct and morals. Hence it should be avoided. One should find out a match in some pious family. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
